fields.name: visitedCountries
fields.label: Visited countries (ISO-2 codes)
fields.description: Comma, space or newline separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes, e.g. JP, FR, BR.

fields.name: nextDestination
fields.label: Next destination text
fields.description: Full text shown in the top left.

fields.name: tripStartDate
fields.label: Trip start date
fields.description: Used for the countdown. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: lineWeight
fields.label: Map line weight
fields.description: Multiplies country border thickness for e-ink dithering. Try 2-4 on Spectra 6; use 1 for the original fine lines.

fields.name: showBorder
fields.label: Show outer border
fields.description: Draws the black frame border around the map panel.

fields.name: theme
fields.label: Theme
fields.description: Color theme for the map. Choose classic, atlas, midnight, forest, terracotta, plum, ocean, graphite, candy, or blue.

worldMapPanel.name: Visited world map panel
worldMapPanel.description: Responsive world map dashboard that highlights visited countries from ISO-2 codes, shows your next destination, counts down to your trip date, and supports adjustable line weight, border and color themes.
